column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST: a registeredBackends test, so it runs one subtest per dialect and mysql and mssql skip in these PostgreSQL-only jobs while postgres RUNS -- two, not three. Measured by name, with only CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES set. Guards cleat#1351's other arm: it distinguishes 'no reason given' from 'reason lost in transit', which a test that always passes a reason cannot. An empty reason must also survive as an empty string rather than becoming a NULL a COALESCE turns into something else, and the COALESCE spelling differs per dialect.
